dct:provenance: Authoritative discovery used the configured Zenodo ICTV community dataset listing and public Zenodo REST API. The listing returned 2 latest dataset records across 1 page; their version endpoints exposed 7 public dataset versions and 7 files, all downloaded and checksum-verified. The crawl was limited to records classified by Zenodo as Dataset in the ICTV community, all pagination links returned by the API, and every public version/file under those records; software records, GitHub links, HTML pages, and non-dataset community records were excluded. XLSX files are spreadsheet packages, not dataset archives for archive-member distribution modeling; worksheet XML was inspected in place and no OOXML implementation parts were promoted as data files. Each RecordSet corresponds to a worksheet with a detectable header in the first five rows. Header tokens were preserved exactly, and datatype samples never exceeded the first five worksheet rows. The community-level name is the exact NIH award title exposed by the Zenodo community API; the description is the exact Zenodo community description, including its source spacing. citeAs is the exact APA citation response returned by DOI content negotiation for the latest Master Species List record, including the response's HTML markup and entity spelling. The canonical CC BY 4.0 URL was verified on the Creative Commons deed; each Zenodo dataset record reports license id cc-by-4.0. conditionsOfAccess is quoted verbatim from Zenodo Terms of Use v1.3. No coherent country/state/city combination or latitude/longitude pair was found in the sampled worksheet headers, so no GeoCoordinates hierarchy was added. description: The ICTV is charged with developing, refining, and maintaining the official, universal  taxonomy of all viruses. The goal is to classify and name all known viruses into a single taxonomy that reflects their evolutionary relationships.
